latitude.title: Confirm authorization and latitude with the human
latitude.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-orchestrator.md and references/global-everyone.md), then docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md and the Active section of .agent-work/LESSONS.md if present. In this context, load constellation-interrogator and settle the latitude contract with the human: epic intent and success shape (honest-null acceptability), checkpoint protocol (stop-and-present vs cleared-through), decision classes delegated vs surfaced, float-up routing for Commander user-decisions, comms style, budget/model parameters, pre-rulings, and contract expiry (time or event). Fill templates/LATITUDE_CONTRACT.template.md into .agent-work/epic-101/LATITUDE_CONTRACT.md. Decisions fitting no listed class are out-of-taxonomy and always escalate. Get explicit human confirmation of the contract.

execute.title: Run the epic
execute.imperative: Before entering this step and before EACH detached wave launch, (re)write the crash-resume state note at .agent-work/epic-101/STATE_NOTE.md (step · slug · next command · PID · expected artifact) from .agent-work/templates/STATE_NOTE.template.md — a wave dies to all three kill vectors, and the engine refuses to start execute until it is filled (precondition p2). Then do what the epic needs within the latitude contract: plan waves, dispatch one Commander per issue (each in an isolated worktree, each with a completed templates/LAUNCH_ORDER.template.md carrying pasted prior-wave verdicts, pre-rulings, honest-null clause, findings-file assignment, stop conditions, and inherited latitude), adjudicate what Commanders float (inside delegated classes as logged RULINGs, otherwise escalate), merge green reviewed PRs sequentially gated on check exit codes, and stop at wave checkpoints per the contract. Log every ruling, incident, wave launch, merge, and owned error in the ADMIRAL_LOG as it happens — an unlogged ruling didn't happen. Never run a Commander's issue yourself; never put two Commanders in one worktree. If the contract expires or the ground shifts under it, surface a contract-refresh decision before continuing.

closeout.title: Lessons audit, reconcile, hygiene, acceptance
closeout.imperative: The run cannot close with unrouted observations. 1) Compile a run brief (epic intent, project-customized templates per the TEMPLATES_MANIFEST diff, model tiers used) and dispatch a fresh-context subagent invoking constellation-lessons-auditor over the artifacts (ADMIRAL_LOG, AGENT_FEEDBACK entries, crew Workflow Feedback, closeout tables); give every returned candidate a routed disposition: template delta, playbook delta, Charter nomination, constellation export (.agent-work/CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.md, carrying the originating lesson id in the entry's Lesson field for stable cross-run recurrence identity), retire, or drop-with-reason. Apply playbook deltas only via py C:/Users/fredc/.claude/skills/constellation-admiral/scripts/apply_lessons_delta.py with tick=true; never edit LESSONS.md directly. 2) Append the epic retrospective to .agent-work/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md. 3) Hand the epic's net change to a constellation-cartographer subagent for architecture reconcile. 4) Hygiene: every branch merged or dispositioned, worktrees swept, ADMIRAL_LOG archived under .agent-work/archive/. 5) Present the epic summary and get user acceptance. Then release the lease: <engine> release --session-id <admiral-session-id>.
